questions.question_text: Identify the part with the error: He is one of the best players (A) / who has ever (B) / played for India. (C) / No Error (D)
questions.explanation: In 'one of the + plural noun + who/which/that', the relative pronoun 'who' refers to the plural noun 'players'. Therefore, the verb must be plural ('have') instead of singular ('has'). Correct usage: 'who have ever'.

questions.question_text: Choose the word nearest in meaning to the word: MITIGATE
questions.explanation: Mitigate means to make something less severe, harmful, or painful. Alleviate is its closest synonym.

questions.question_text: Mirage is an optical illusion which occurs due to:
questions.explanation: A mirage is a naturally occurring optical phenomenon in which light rays bend via total internal reflection to produce a displaced image of distant objects or the sky.
The slogan 'Inquilab Zindabad' (Long Live the Revolution) was coined by Maulana Hasrat Mohani in 1921. It was popularized by Bhagat Singh.

questions.question_text: What is the pH value of pure water?
questions.explanation: Pure water is neutral, meaning it is neither acidic nor basic. Its pH is exactly 7 at 25°C.

questions.question_text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to the word: EPHEMERAL
questions.explanation: Ephemeral means lasting for a very short time. Its exact opposite is permanent.

questions.question_text: Which is the largest desert in the world (including polar regions)?
questions.explanation: The Antarctic Desert is the largest desert on Earth, covering the continent of Antarctica. Deserts are defined by their low precipitation, not temperature.

questions.question_text: Improve the bracketed part of the sentence: Scarcely had I reached the station (than) the train arrived.
questions.explanation: The conjunction 'scarcely' is followed by 'when' or 'before'. 'No sooner' is followed by 'than'.

questions.question_text: Who appoints the Chief of Army Staff in India?
questions.explanation: The President of India is the Supreme Commander of the Indian Armed Forces and appoints the Chiefs of the Army, Navy, and Air Force.

questions.question_text: Which vitamin is synthesized in the human body by exposure to sunlight?
questions.explanation: Vitamin D is synthesized by the human body when the skin is exposed to ultraviolet B (UVB) rays from sunlight.
